description: Source code for QuicTimeWaitListManager class, managing QUIC time-wait list, connection IDs, and related packet handling.

classes.name: ConnectionIdCleanUpAlarm
classes.description: Alarm delegate to trigger cleanup of old connection IDs in QuicTimeWaitListManager.

classes.name: TimeWaitConnectionInfo
classes.description: Holds information about a connection in the time-wait state, including termination packets and active connection IDs.

classes.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager
classes.description: Manages the QUIC time-wait list, including adding/removing connection IDs, processing packets, and handling timeouts.

methods.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::AddConnectionIdToTimeWait
methods.description: Adds a connection ID to the time-wait list with specified action and info.

methods.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an incoming packet for a connection in the time-wait list, possibly sending resets or termination packets.

methods.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::SendVersionNegotiationPacket
methods.description: Sends a version negotiation packet to a peer.

methods.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::SendPublicReset
methods.description: Sends a public reset packet in response to a connection.

methods.name: QuicTimeWaitListManager::BuildIetfStatelessResetPacket
methods.description: Builds an IETF-style stateless reset packet.
